messages:
Alex: Quick sync — planning a staged rollout for model v12. Plan: region-prioritized then percent ramp. Need sign-off on guardrails.
Maya: :thumbsup: prefer EU->NA->APAC, start at 2% EU then 5% NA after 1h if error < 0.5%
Zane: add cache-warming step before percent bump, TTL priming.
Priya: please add automatic abort: 0.8% 5xx over 10m OR latency p95 > 800ms -> rollback.
Alex: Drafting flag config: 
```json
{
  "feature": "model_v12_ramp",
  "schedule": [
    {"region":"eu", "pct":2},
    {"region":"na", "pct":5, "delay":"1h"},
    {"region":"apac", "pct":1, "delay":"2h"}
  ],
  "abort_conditions": {"5xx_pct":0.8, "latency_p95_ms":800}
}
```
Maya: can we add sticky-sessions to ensure consistent KV cache across retries? @Zane
Zane: yes, use `session_affinity: ip_or_user` in gateway config. Also priming job: `scripts/prime_kv.sh --model=v12 --q=1000`
DeployBot: rollout plan queued, will start at 2026-04-02T09:00Z. Job id: r-88421
Alex: Good. I'll add a canary test set and a smoke eval run after EU bump. Anyone want to own the smoke eval?
Priya: I'll own smoke eval & monitor dashboard. Will post thresholds.
Maya: I'll validate infra config and ensure capacity headroom for NA bump.
Zane: I'll run priming job 15m before start and confirm logs.
Alex: thanks — I'll update the feature flag doc and assign permissions. If no objections, we proceed tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya: +1
Maya: +1
Zane: +1
